section01Body: South City Greens is a premium plotted residential township in Sector 36, Jhajjar, developed under the Deen Dayal Jan Awas Yojana. Spread across 20 acres, it stands as the largest single-licence plotted development in Jhajjar and is located just a 2-minute drive from the upcoming 75-metre-wide road proposed under the Government of Haryana’s Master Plan 2031. Featuring wide 9-metre internal roads, thoughtfully designed green pockets and modern infrastructure, the township offers well-planned residential plots for families and investors seeking a peaceful, well-connected and future-ready address in Jhajjar.
